subject: Re: appointment time options
text:
Thank you for reaching out and for your interest in the appointment. As a student balancing campus commitments, I reviewed the request for Thursday at 4:00 p.m., and I want to make sure we can give our session proper time and focus. I am currently able to begin at 3:30 p.m., not 4:00, because the study room we rely on closes at 5:15 and I need a few minutes afterward to secure my materials. I understand this may feel slightly earlier than you hoped, and I appreciate you letting me mention it before confirming.

If 3:30 is manageable, I would be glad to reserve the slot and send a brief outline in advance. If Thursday does not work, I also have openings on Friday mornings and Saturday midday. My goal is to make the first meeting useful for your schedule and for the scope we discussed. Please let me know which option you prefer, and I will adjust the confirmation accordingly. If you prefer the top of the hour, I can suggest Tuesday at 4:15, though the same room limitation applies only to Thursday. I am happy to share a short intake form before we meet. That way, our first session can focus on the issues that matter most to you.

Kind regards,
